meta.description: Wing Staff is comprised of the Wing Command staff, Command Post, Inspector General, Safety, PublicAffairs, Judge Advocate General, Chaplain Corps, and the Comptroller Flight (Finance). All offices areadministrative in nature. Safety and Public Affairs are required to work on the flightline and around moving equipment/aircraft
meta.jhaNotes:
Primary work hazards include:- Office ergonomics, including repetitive-motion, workstation, and manual-material-handling hazards.- Slips, trips, and falls from cords, wet floors, uneven surfaces, stairways, ladders, and elevated work.- Electrical hazards associated with office equipment, power strips, damanged cords, and unauthorized
equipment.- Fire, evacuation, severe weather, and emergency response hazards.- Cleaning chemical exposure, including disinfectants, bleach, and other common-area cleaning
products.- Noise, flying debris, high-pressure water, chemical splash, vibration, and struck-by hazards when
personnel volunteer or are assigned lawn-care, pressure-washing, facility-maintenance, or similar
support tasks.- Vehicle, pedestrian, bicycle, parking-lot, and flight-line hazards when performing duties outside the
office area.
Applicable guidance and references:
Employees will follow applicable technical orders, job guides, manufacturer instructions, Safety Data
Sheets (SDS), approved work instructions, job orders, risk-management documentation (Deliberate
Risks Assessment Worksheets), and Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs), when applicable
